title: A gallery of apps
summary: Discover and install curated apps, enjoy refreshed built-in apps, and try the redesigned mobile app.

highlights.title: App gallery
highlights.body: Discover curated apps, read their details and install them safely. Built-in apps and games have fresh artwork and a cleaner look.

highlights.title: Redesigned mobile app
highlights.body: The mobile app moves to bottom tabs with a new icon. Attach photos and files, pick skills from the composer and copy or share any message.

items.text: Apps can use your connected integrations and AI, with your permission.
Claude chats can use your connected integrations and custom MCP servers.
Inbox Triage now runs on Matrix bots.
Your personal Matrix bot follows your personality settings.
Paste from the terminal's right-click menu.
Chat navigation loads faster and works the same in Chat and Projects.
Your remaining allowance is easier to read.
Project sharing matches the new design.
Claude Code chats always use your Claude subscription.
Account artwork no longer sits under the window controls.
Bots can be created again, from scratch or a preset, with the right model.
Bots ask for Gmail access and show connected accounts.
Starter credit is granted once your account is active.
Settings prefers the Claude CLI Matrix manages, and ChatGPT sign-ins recover.
